app.name: GO CODE
app.short_description: Pixel-art squad tactics: plan, stack, breach (Classic Controller)
app.long_description:
Lead a four-operator hostage rescue team through ten night missions. Plan each operator's route on the floor plan, stack them on the doors, then call the GO code: charges blow, flashbangs pop, and the team storms in.
VEGA (point, flashbangs), KNOX (breacher, charges), PIKE (recon, drone, silenced SMG) and MAE (medic, smoke, revives).
Progress saves to the SD card after every mission.
Controls (Classic Controller): Planning: stick/D-pad cursor, A waypoint, B undo, Y wait for GO, X ability, ZL/ZR operator, + start Assault: X GO code, ZL/ZR select, left stick take control (right stick aims), A back to plan, Y ability now, R replan, L camera, + pause -: 16:9 / 4:3 screen HOME: exit
